Translate one chart's spec into prep_chart() arguments

chart_args_from_spec.Rd

Pure mapping from the two spec tables plus the table from build_chart_data to a named list you can do.call(prep_chart, ...) — or inspect first. Rules applied here, all mirroring prep_chart's own:

  • only plot == TRUE rows are plotted, in position order;

  • rolling/growth/index are NULL (already applied by build_chart_data);

  • blank y_axis falls back to default_y_axis;

  • dashed/dotted logical columns become index vectors;

  • the second area series gets NA legend;

  • a literal \n in title, y_axis or note becomes a line break;

  • legend_columns_<lang> is used if present, else legend_columns, else 2;

  • colour all-numeric strings become palette indices;

  • xmin/xmax/forecast_* go through parse_spec_date: ISO or period form only.

Usage

chart_args_from_spec(chart, series_rows, wide, language = "si")

Arguments

chart

one row of the charts table

series_rows

this chart's rows of the chart_series table (aliases filled)

wide

the table from build_chart_data

language

"si" or "en" — picks the _sl/_en columns

Value

named list of prep_chart arguments
